clips.title: The story
paras: At Hammerfall, Drum Fel directs the Horde’s fight to hold Arathi against trolls, ogres, and human remnants. With his wife Korin, he works to secure a lasting foothold for the Horde in the region.

Drum Fel commands Hammerfall’s defenses and the Horde’s push into Arathi. From the fortified refuge, he faces rival factions on every side. The Witherbark forest trolls and the Boulderfist ogres hold Boulder'gor and Boulderfist Hall. Drum knows Hammerfall cannot thrive by keeping to itself; its neighbors’ strength must be broken. He sends veteran champions into hostile territory to disrupt these threats before they can strike the Horde encampment.
